title: #129 Aeroplanes or Cars
prompt: Which one has the greater impact on human’s life, aeroplanes or cars?

promptSegments.text: Which one has the greater impact on human’s life, aeroplanes or cars?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Planes have a greater impact on human life because they allow people to travel long distances quickly and connect different parts of the world.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Planes have a greater impact on human life because they allow people to travel long distances quickly and connect different parts of the world.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars also affect human life by giving people the chance to go where they want on the road, allowing them to explore nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars also affect human life by giving people the chance to go where they want on the road, allowing them to explore nature.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Aeroplanes are better for long-distance travel and connecting people globally.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Aeroplanes are better for long-distance travel and connecting people globally.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars are better for daily, local travel and giving people freedom near home.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars are better for daily, local travel and giving people freedom near home.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Aeroplanes have a massive impact on human life because they connect people across great distances quickly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Aeroplanes have a massive impact on human life because they connect people across great distances quickly.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars also have a major impact on human life, especially in daily routines.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars also have a major impact on human life, especially in daily routines.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Aeroplanes are crucial for global trade and connecting distant economies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Aeroplanes are crucial for global trade and connecting distant economies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars provide essential personal freedom and mobility for daily life and local journeys.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars provide essential personal freedom and mobility for daily life and local journeys.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Compare the impacts of aeroplanes and cars on human life, focusing on their roles in transportation, environmental effects, and economic influence.
outline: body1: Aeroplanes' impact - global connectivity, economic growth, but high emissions
body2: Cars' impact - personal mobility, urbanization, but resource consumption
keyArguments: Aeroplanes have a greater global impact due to their role in globalization and long-distance travel, despite their environmental costs.
Cars influence daily life and urban development more directly, contributing to personal convenience but with significant resource and pollution implications.

outline: body1: Aeroplanes' impact - global connectivity, economic growth, but high emissions
body2: Cars' impact - personal mobility, urbanization, but resource consumption
keyArguments: Aeroplanes have a greater global impact due to their role in globalization and long-distance travel, despite their environmental costs.
Cars influence daily life and urban development more directly, contributing to personal convenience but with significant resource and pollution implications.
